incidents_catalogued.title: Historical Baseline Inflation in Narrative Tables
incidents_catalogued.location: experiments/EXP-07/ historical reports (C15, C16, C17, C18, C19 narrative tables)
incidents_catalogued.claimed_value: C8/C10 historical baselines achieved ~0.4072 (40.7%) DEV phenomena mIoU, framing C16 (0.0494) as an ~88% catastrophic collapse.
incidents_catalogued.machine_truth: Direct forensic audit of Level 5 machine artifacts (checkpoints, training results, and logs) proved C8 best DEV phenomena mIoU was 0.119031 (11.90%) and C10 was 0.137819 (13.78%). The claimed 0.4072 was a narrative transcription error introduced in C15.
incidents_catalogued.root_cause: Unverified narrative transcription of an all-class/background-inclusive metric into a phenomena-only column in C15 report without cross-checking machine JSON artifacts.
incidents_catalogued.remediation: Established exact Level 5 machine truth in C20 and C21 audit records. Formulated GOV-RULE-100 requiring machine traceability for all historical baseline claims.

incidents_catalogued.title: Dataset Freeze Specification Version Ambiguity
incidents_catalogued.location: C16 run records (OPS02_v1.0.0_FROZEN) vs C19 protocol reconciliation table (OPS02_v1.0.1_FROZEN)
incidents_catalogued.claimed_value: C19 protocol table referenced OPS02_v1.0.1_FROZEN as canonical post-freeze dataset identity, creating ambiguity whether C16 trained on an unpatched or obsolete dataset.
incidents_catalogued.machine_truth: SHA256 hashes of physical tiles, ground-truth masks, spatial dimensions (256x256), and partition assignments (132 TRAIN, 40 DEV, 40 HOLDOUT) are 100% bitwise identical between v1.0.0 and v1.0.1. The difference was exclusively a documentation text correction fixing a narrative transcription typo (41/39 to 40/40 DEV/HOLDOUT).
incidents_catalogued.root_cause: Specification version increment applied to documentation without explicitly annotating that physical bytes remained immutable.
incidents_catalogued.remediation: Preserved C16's historical provenance as v1.0.0 while recording v1.0.1 as canonical specification identity. Physical data identity is bitwise identical.

incidents_catalogued.title: Checkpoint Serialization Format Polymorphism
incidents_catalogued.claimed_value: Assumed homogeneous serialization structure across all historical EXP-07 checkpoints.
incidents_catalogued.machine_truth: C8 and C10 checkpoints (171.9 MB each) encapsulate full training dictionaries, whereas C16 checkpoint (57.4 MB) contains only the model OrderedDict state_dict.
incidents_catalogued.root_cause: Evolution of training checkpoint export routines between C8/C10 and C16.
incidents_catalogued.remediation: Implemented polymorphic checkpoint unwrapping in evaluation scripts without altering raw checkpoint bytes.

incidents_catalogued.title: Overgeneralized Input Normalization Superiority Narrative
incidents_catalogued.claimed_value: Model-declared normalization yielded consistently superior transfer fidelity across all evaluated models.
incidents_catalogued.machine_truth: In EVAL-A (C16 -> OPS-01 DEV), Target-Native Normalization achieved 0.028818 mIoU, which is higher than Model-Declared Normalization (0.027285 mIoU). In EVAL-B and EVAL-C, Model-Declared was higher (0.035332 vs 0.019896, and 0.029223 vs 0.019455).
incidents_catalogued.root_cause: Narrative generalization across evaluations without verifying per-evaluation directionality.
incidents_catalogued.remediation: Rectified in C21 post-audit: Normalization transfer sensitivity is formally defined as EVALUATION-DEPENDENT.

incidents_catalogued.title: Unsupported Causal Attribution of Performance Bounds to Dataset Domain Properties
incidents_catalogued.claimed_value: OPS-02 performance is fundamentally bounded by dataset domain properties rather than an optimization failure.
incidents_catalogued.machine_truth: Cross-domain evaluation is observational and provides descriptive transfer data only. It does not isolate or manipulate optimization mechanisms.
incidents_catalogued.root_cause: Conflating descriptive cross-domain performance degradation with proof of causal limitation source.
incidents_catalogued.remediation: Restricted claim to descriptive domain transfer evidence. Optimization vs domain bounds remains an open empirical question to be investigated by single-variable diagnostics.

incidents_catalogued.title: Equating Guardrail Test Passes with '100% Bug-Free' Pipeline
incidents_catalogued.claimed_value: The pipeline is 100% bug-free and robust.
incidents_catalogued.machine_truth: Passing 72 automated guardrails verifies that checked invariants hold; it does not prove universal absence of bugs across untested paths.
incidents_catalogued.root_cause: Epistemic overclaim confusing bounded empirical verification with universal mathematical correctness.
incidents_catalogued.remediation: Updated language: 'Verified against the implemented guardrail suite and audited invariants.'

incidents_catalogued.title: Unverified Attribution of C8/C10 Performance Gap to Isolated Seed Variance
incidents_catalogued.claimed_value: C8 (seed 42) and C10 (seed 101) provide a clean, isolated measurement of random seed variance on OPS-01.
incidents_catalogued.machine_truth: Historical execution records indicate C8 and C10 were executed under differing runtime conditions that have not been machine-proven identical in all respects except seed.
incidents_catalogued.root_cause: Assuming two historical runs with different seed numbers represent isolated seed variance without verifying complete execution parity.
incidents_catalogued.remediation: Documented that C8/C10 seed variance is an unisolated observation. Seed variance must not be cited as a clean baseline without proof of execution parity.

incidents_catalogued.title: Canonical Loss-Weight Vector Numeric Precision Resolution
incidents_catalogued.claimed_value: Question whether C16 executed weights with higher precision than the documented 6-decimal constants.
incidents_catalogued.machine_truth: Forensic audit of scratch/kaggle_replicate003_kernel/train_replicate003.py lines 56-69 (the exact script executed on Kaggle in C16) and ops02_c18_class_weights_audit_v1.json confirmed that C16 ingested the exact 6-decimal literal constants from the C15 protocol. Formula derivation in float64 rounded to 6 decimals matches these constants exactly with residual difference < 5e-7 (below float32 epsilon).
incidents_catalogued.root_cause: Pre-implementation precision audit required before protocol freeze.
incidents_catalogued.remediation: Established that Historical C16 Executed Vector and Future EXP07_DIAG01 Control Vector are exactly equal to 6 decimal places: [0.403935, 2.450546, 0.876692, 0.945945, 0.648189, 4.211476, 0.719641, 2.956203, 1.064525, 1.882870, 0.387652, 18.243211].

remediation_summary: All 8 catalogued incidents are audited, root-caused, and governed. Zero open blocking incidents remain.
